elements.label: text
elements.text: Thank you very much for buying a BROTHER sewing machine. Before using your new machine, please read the safety instructions and the explanations given in the instruction manual.

elements.label: text
elements.text: With industrial sewing machines, it is normal to carry out work while positioned directly in front of moving parts such as the needle and thread take-up, and consequently there is always a danger of injury that can be caused by these parts. Follow the instructions from training personnel and instructors regarding safe and correct operation before operating the machine so that you will know how to use it correctly.

elements.text: SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: [1] Safety indications and their meanings

elements.label: text
elements.text: This instruction manual and the indications and symbols that are used on the machine itself are provided in order to ensure safe operation of this machine and to prevent accidents and injury to yourself or other people.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The meanings of these indications and symbols are given below.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: Indications

elements.label: text
elements.text: DANGER The instructions which follow this term indicate situations where failure to follow the instructions will result in death or serious injury.

elements.label: text
elements.text: WARNING The instructions which follow this term indicate situations where failure to follow the instructions could result in death or serious injury.

elements.label: text
elements.text: CAUTION The instructions which follow this term indicate situations where failure to follow the instructions may result in minor or moderate injury.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: Environmental requirements

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use the sewing machine in an area which is free from sources of strong electrical noise such as electrical line noise or static electric noise. Sources of strong electrical noise may cause

elements.label: text
elements.text: problems with correct operation.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Any fluctuations in the power supply voltage should be within ±10% of the rated voltage for the machine.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Voltage fluctuations which are greater than this may cause problems with correct operation.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The power supply capacity should be greater than the requirements for the sewing machine's power consumption.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Insufficient power supply capacity may cause problems with correct operation.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: Installation

elements.label: text
elements.text: Machine installation should only be carried out by a qualified technician.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Contact your Brother dealer or a qualified electrician for any electrical work that may need to be done.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The sewing machine weighs approximately 34.5 kg (76lb). The installation should be carried out by two or more people.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Do not connect the power cord until installation is complete. The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before inserting or removing the plug, otherwise damage to the control box could result.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Be sure to connect the ground. If the ground connection is not secure, you run a high risk of receiving a serious electric shock, and problems with correct operation may also occur.

elements.label: text
elements.text: When securing the cords, do not bend the cords excessively or fasten them too hard with staples, otherwise there is the danger that fire or electric shocks could occur.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The ambient temperature should be within the range of 5°C to 35°C during use.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Temperatures which are lower or higher than this may cause problems with correct operation.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The relative humidity should be within the range of 45% to 85% during use, and no dew formation should occur in any devices.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Excessively dry or humid environments and dew formation may cause problems with correct operation.

elements.label: text
elements.text: In the event of an electrical storm, turn off the power and disconnect the power cord from the wall outlet. Lightning may cause problems with correct operation.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Do not connect anything to the USB port other than the USB memory. If this is not observed, problems with operation may result.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If using a work table which has casters, the casters should be secured in such a way so that they cannot move.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Secure the table so that it will not move when tilting back the machine head. If the table moves, it may crush your feet or cause other injuries.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use both hands to hold the machine head when tilting it back or returning it to its original position. If only one hand is used, the weight of the machine head may cause your hand to slip, and your hand may get caught.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Be sure to wear protective goggles and gloves when handling the lubricating oil and grease, so that they do not get into your eyes or onto your skin, otherwise inflammation can result.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Furthermore, do not drink the oil or eat the grease under any circumstances, as they can cause vomiting and diarrhea.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Keep the oil out of the reach of children.

elements.label: text
elements.text: When cutting the nozzle of the oil tank, hold the base of the nozzle securely.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If you hold the end of the nozzle, injury from the scissors may result.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The sewing machine should always be lubricated and the oil supply replenished before it is used for the first time, and also after long periods of non-use.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Hold the base of the nozzle of the accessory oil tank (1), and use scissors to cut about half-way along the straight section (A) of the nozzle.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen and remove the nozzle, and then remove the seal (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the nozzle.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Open the oil feeding pocket cover (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Insert the nozzle of the oil tank (1) deeply into the oil feeding pocket (4), and then add about 120 ml of lubricating oil.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check that the oil gauge (6) comes to the upper reference line in the oil gauge window (5).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Close the oil feeding pocket cover (3).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-5. Test operation (Operating the treadle)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: CAUTION

elements.label: text
elements.text: Do not touch any of the moving parts or press any objects against the machine while sewing, as this may result in personal injury or damage to the machine.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 1. Turning on the power

elements.label: text
elements.text: Press the ON power switch (1).

elements.label: text
elements.text: The power indicator (2) will illuminate.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The display (3) of the operation panel will change in the order shown in the illustration. (During this time, the feed mechanism will return to the home position.)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-6. Adjusting the treadle

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 2. Test operation

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check that the machine sews at low speed when the treadle (1) is gently pressed to position (B).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Then check that it sews at high speed when the treadle (1) is gently pressed to position (C).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After pressing the treadle (1) forward, check that the needle is lowered to the top of the needle plate when the treadle (1) is returned to the neutral position (A). (when needle down stopping has been set.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If the treadle (1) is pressed to position (D), thread trimming is carried out and the needle then rises above the needle plate and stops.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Forward depression sensitivity adjustment>

elements.label: text
elements.text: If the machine starts running at low speed when your foot is simply resting on the treadle, or if the treadle pressure is felt to be too weak, adjust the position (a to c) at which the treadle spring (1) is hooked onto the treadle lever (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: a is the weakest position, and it becomes gradually stronger at b, c and d respectively.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Backward depression sensitivity adjustment>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the nut (3) and turn the bolt (4).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When the bolt (4) is tightened, the treadle operation becomes heavier, and when it is loosened, the operation becomes lighter.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the nut (3).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: < Adjusting the treadle stroke >

elements.label: text
elements.text: Remove the nut (5), and then move the connecting rod joint (6) from the position in figure A to the position in figure B. The treadle stroke will then be increased by approximately 27 %.

elements.label: text
elements.text: At this time, the treadle forward and backward depression sensitivity will change, so readjust if necessary.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4. PREPARATION BEFORE SEWING

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-1. Installing the needle

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before installing the needle. The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-2. Removing the bobbin case

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to move the needle bar to its highest position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Insert the needle (2) in a straight line as far as it will go, making sure that the long groove on the needle is at the left, and then securely tighten the screw (1).

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before removing the bobbin case.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to raise the needle until it is above the needle plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Pull the latch (1) of the bobbin case upward and then remove the bobbin case.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The bobbin (2) will come out when the latch (1) is released.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: There is an anti-spin spring (3) inside the bobbin case. The anti-spin spring (3) prevents the bobbin from racing at times such as during thread trimming.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Use bobbins (2) made of light alloy as specified by BROTHER.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-3. Winding the lower thread

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: CAUTION

elements.label: text
elements.text: Do not touch any of the moving parts or press any objects against the machine while winding the lower thread, as this may result in personal injury or damage to the machine.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn on the power switch.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Place the bobbin (1) onto the bobbin winder shaft (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Wind the thread several times around the bobbin (1) in the direction indicated by the arrow.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Push the bobbin presser arm (3) toward the bobbin(1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Raise the presser foot with the lifting lever.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Depress the treadle. Lower thread winding will then start.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Once winding of the lower thread is completed, the bobbin presser arm (3) will return automatically.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After the thread has been wound on, remove the bobbin and cut the thread with the knife (4).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw (5) and move the bobbin presser (6) to adjust the amount of thread wound onto the bobbin.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: NOTE:

elements.label: text
elements.text: The amount of thread wound onto the bobbin should be a maximum of 80 % of the bobbin capacity.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-4. Installing the bobbin case

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before installing the bobbin case. The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to raise the needle until it is above the needle plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: While holding the bobbin so that the thread winds to the right, insert the bobbin into the bobbin case.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Pass the thread through the slot (1) and under the tension spring (2), and then pull it out from the thread guide (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check that the bobbin turns clockwise when the thread is pulled.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Hold the latch (4) on the bobbin case and insert the bobbin case into the rotary hook.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-5. Threading the upper thread

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: CAUTION

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before threading the upper thread.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley and raise the thread take-up (1) before threading the upper thread. This will make threading easier and it will prevent the thread from coming out at the sewing start.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-6. Using the knee lifter

elements.label: text
elements.text: The presser foot (2) can be raised by pressing the knee lifter plate (1).

elements.text: 5-4. Program setting method

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ It is recommended that you register patterns that are sewn frequently as programs. After programs have been registered, you can retrieve the desired sewing patterns simply by selecting a program number, which eliminates the need to set the pattern each time.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ Settings such as sewing pattern, number of stitches, stitch pitch, sewing speed and slow start can be made separately for each program number.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ Up to nine programs from P1 to P9 can be registered.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: At the time of shipment from the factory, P1 to P8 have normal sewing programs registered, and P9 has a 4-step fixed stitch sewing (name label sewing) program registered.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-6. Using the production counter

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ The production counter can be used to let you know how many items have been sewn.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ The production counter increases by 1 each time thread trimming is carried out.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: For the detailed home screen

elements.label: text
elements.text: Set the counter display so that it is displaying the production counter icon, and then keep pressing the production counter key to switch to production counter editing mode.

elements.label: text
elements.text: 1 Switching to production counter editing mode

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: For the simple home screen

elements.label: text
elements.text: Keep pressing the production counter key to switch to production counter editing mode.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: For the menu screen

elements.label: text
elements.text: Select "Production counter editing" to switch to the production counter editing screen.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ Use the + and - keys to change the value of the production counter (1). When the value is changed, the production counter (1) will flash.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ If you would like to return the setting to "0000", press the Clear key.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ If you press the OK key, the value will be confirmed and the display will return to the home screen.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-7. Using the lower thread counter

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ The lower thread counter can be used to let you know approximately how much lower thread is remaining. * The lower thread counter should be used as a guide only.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ The value displayed by the lower thread counter display is reduced by 0.1 from the initial setting value each time the number of stitches x sewing pitch reaches 0.1 m, and a warning is given when the counter goes below 0.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 1 Switching to lower thread counter setting mode

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: For the detailed home screen

elements.label: text
elements.text: Set the counter display so that it is displaying the lower thread counter icon, and then keep pressing the lower thread counter key to switch to lower thread counter setting mode.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: For the simple home screen

elements.label: text
elements.text: Keep pressing the lower thread counter key to switch to lower thread counter setting mode.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: For the menu screen

elements.label: text
elements.text: Select "Bobbin thread counter setting" to switch to lower thread counter setting mode.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ You can use the ON/OFF key to turn the counter function on and off. * When the function is turned off, "---" will appear in the counter display (1) and the counter will not operate while sewing is carried out.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ Use the + and - keys to set the value for the lower thread counter. When the value is changed, the lower thread counter (1) will flash. The setting range is from 0.1 to 99.9 m.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ You can press the Reset key to provisionally reset the value to the one which was set previously (only if the counter function was turned on).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ If you press the OK key, the value will be confirmed and the display will return to the home screen.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Lower thread counter operation>

elements.label: text
elements.text: When sewing is carried out, the value shown in the lower thread counter display is reduced by 0.1 each time the number of stitches x sewing pitch reaches 0.1 m.

elements.label: text
elements.text: However, the display is only updated when the treadle is returned to the neutral position.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Lower thread out warning when sewing stops (before thread trimming)>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If the lower thread counter has dropped to below 0 when the sewing machine stops sewing, the warning buzzer sounds 5 times (1 second on/1 second off), and a lower thread counter warning message is displayed.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Sewing will not be possible even if the treadle is depressed forward.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: <If replacing the bobbin>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Depress the treadle backward to trim the thread.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Replace the bobbin.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the Reset key.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The lower thread counter value will return to the value which was previously set.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <If not replacing the bobbin>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the return key.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The lower thread counter value will remain unchanged.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The display will return to the screen which was being displayed before the lower thread counter out warning appeared, and sewing will be possible.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Lower thread out warning when sewing is complete (after thread trimming)>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If the lower thread counter has dropped to below 0 after sewing is complete, the warning buzzer sounds 5 times (1 second on/1 second off), and a lower thread counter warning message is displayed.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Sewing will not be possible even if the treadle is depressed forward.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Replace the bobbin.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the Reset key.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The lower thread counter value will return to the value which was previously set.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The display will return to the screen which was being displayed before the lower thread counter out warning appeared, and sewing will be possible.

elements.label: text
elements.text: 2 <Add/delete step mode> Steps can be added (up to a maximum of 20 steps) to or deleted (to a minimum of 1 step) from the currently-selected program.

elements.text: However, if fixed stitch sewing or reverse fixed stitch sewing is not selected, it will not be possible to switch to this mode.

elements.text: ★ When deleting a step

elements.label: text
elements.text: Press the key (4) to delete the step at the current cursor position. However, if only 1 step is remaining, the delete key will be disabled.

elements.label: text

elements.text: 6-3. Sewing start step setting

elements.label: text
elements.text: If sewing is interrupted by a problem such as a thread breakage occurring and you need to resume sewing from the point where sewing was interrupted, you can start sewing from the middle of a step.

elements.label: text

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: At the detailed home screen, press the menu key.

elements.text: To create a program with parameters that are almost exactly the same as those of another program, you can copy the original program and change just the parts which need to be changed.

elements.label: text
elements.text: 6-10-2. 2nd correction pitch setting

elements.label: text
elements.text: Normally, correction sewing is carried out at the currently-set sewing pitch. However, when "Correction sewing at 2nd correction pitch" is set for carrying out correction sewing, then correction sewing is carried out at the pitch which is set below.

elements.label: text
elements.text: 1 <Switching to correction 2nd pitch ratio screen>

elements.label: text
elements.text: At the hand switch setting screen, select "Correction 2nd pitch ratio".

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use the + or + key to set the ratio (1) with respect to the current pitch. The setting range is from 10% to 250%.

elements.label: text

elements.text: 6-10-3. 2nd pitch setting

elements.label: text
elements.text: If "2nd pitch" has been set and the hand switch is pressed during sewing, the stitch pitch will change to the pitch set as follows.

elements.label: text
elements.text: 1 <Switching to 2nd pitch ratio screen>

elements.label: text
elements.text: At the hand switch setting screen, select "2nd pitch ratio".

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use the + or + key to set the ratio (1) with respect to the current pitch. The setting range is from 10% to 250%.

elements.label: text
elements.text: ・ Press the return key to return to the previous screen. ・ Press the menu key to return to the menu screen.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 6-12. Resetting all settings to their defaults

elements.label: text
elements.text: If the sewing machine stops operating normally, the cause may be that an incorrect setting may have been made for the memory data by means of memory switches, for instance. In such cases, it may be possible to restore normal operation by following the steps given below to initialize the stored data.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 1 Switching to initialization mode and initialization method

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: While pressing the home key, turn on the power to switch to the initialization menu screen.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: At the initialization menu screen, you can select the items to be initialized.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When you select an item to be initialized, the "Are you sure you want to initialize?" confirmation screen will be displayed. Press OK to carry out the initialization. When initialization is complete, the display will return to the initialization menu screen.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 2 To exit from the initialization menu screen

elements.label: text
elements.text: At the initialization menu screen, press the home key to close the initialization menu and switch to the home screen.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 7. SEWING

elements.label: text
elements.text: Attach all safety devices before using the sewing machine. If the machine is used without these devices attached, injury may result.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch at the following times.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text:  When threading the needle

elements.label: list_item
elements.text:  When replacing the bobbin and needle

elements.label: list_item
elements.text:  When not using the machine and when leaving the machine unattended

elements.label: text
elements.text: Do not touch any of the moving parts or press any objects against the machine while sewing, as this may result in personal injury or damage to the machine.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Secure the table so that it will not move when tilting back the machine head. If the table moves, it may crush your feet or cause other injuries.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use both hands to hold the machine head when tilting it back or returning it to its original position. If only one hand is used, the weight of the machine head may cause your hand to slip, and your hand may get caught.

elements.text: When hand switch B (1) is pressed during sewing, the feed direction will be reversed. When it is released, the feed direction will return to normal.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 8-1. Best PFM mode (short trailing length/bird's nest reduction mode)

elements.label: text
elements.text: This mode reduces the occurrence of bird's nests at the sewing start, and shortens the length of thread trailing out from the material at the sewing end.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Setting method>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the thread wiper key (1), slow start key (2) and best PFM mode key (3) so that the icons shown in the illustration illuminate. (Refer to "5-5-8. Best PFM mode".)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust the tension for the pre-tension (4) so that the upper thread trailing length is 25 to 30 mm (spun thread) or 28 to 33 mm (polyester thread).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 8-2. Using X-over seam assist mode

elements.label: text
elements.text: The X-over seam sensor reduces the occurrence of tangled threads and broken needles during X-over seam sewing.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Setting method>

elements.label: list_item

elements.text: 2-3. Select "Feed amount correction at crossing of X-over seam", and then set the correction amount. (* The figure is a percentage, so for example, if you set it to "+1", the sewing pitch will increase by 1% of the main sewing pitch.)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 9-1. Adjusting the thread tension

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before removing or inserting the bobbin case. The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Good even stitches

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Lower thread tension>

elements.label: text
elements.text: Adjust by turning the adjustment screw (1) until the case drops gently by its own weight while the thread end coming out of the bobbin case is held.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Upper thread tension>

elements.label: text
elements.text: After the lower thread tension has been adjusted, adjust the upper thread tension so that a good, even stitch is obtained.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Lower the presser foot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust by turning the tension nut (2).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 9-2. Adjusting the presser foot pressure

elements.label: text
elements.text: Good even stitches The presser foot pressure should be as weak as possible, but strong enough so that the material does not slip.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the adjusting nut (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the presser adjusting screw (2) to adjust the presser foot pressure.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the adjusting nut (1).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 9-3. Adjusting the trailing length after thread trimming

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ At the time of thread trimming, the thread tension is loosened and tension is applied by the pretension (1) only.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ The standard upper thread trailing length is 25 to 30 mm.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ If the tension of the pretension (1) is increased, the lengths of the threads trailing from the needle tips will be reduced; if the tension is reduced, the lengths will be increased.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Adjust by turning the pretension (1).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 9-4. Adjusting the thread take-up amount (-[][]3 specifications)

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before carrying out these operations.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: caption
elements.text: NOTE: Do not use this function with models that are not -[][]3 specifications.

elements.label: text
elements.text: When sewing heavy materials, the thread tension can be adjusted more easily if the thread take-up amount is set to a larger amount.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the face plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Use a hexagonal wrench to loosen the set screws (1) and (2) by approximately two turns.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust the thread take-up amount.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <To increase the thread take-up amount>

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn the thread take-up support shaft (3) clockwise so that the groove (4) is facing straight upward.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <To return the thread take-up amount to the standard setting>

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn the thread take-up support shaft (3) counterclockwise so that the groove (4) is facing straight downward.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: With the thread take-up support shaft (3) pushed in as far as it will go, first tighten the set screw (1) until it touches the screw stop on the thread take-up support shaft (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After this, tighten the set screw (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install the face plate.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 10. CLEANING

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before carrying out these operations.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Be sure to wear protective goggles and gloves when handling the grease so that it does not get into your eyes or onto your skin. Otherwise inflammation can result.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Furthermore, do not drink the oil or eat the grease under any circumstances. Diarrhea or vomiting may result. Keep the oil out of the reach of children.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Secure the table so that it will not move when tilting back the machine head.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If the table moves, it may crush your feet or cause other injuries.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use both hands to hold the machine head when tilting it back or returning it to its original position.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If only one hand is used, the weight of the machine head may cause your hand to slip, and your hand may get caught.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 10-1. Daily cleaning procedures

elements.label: text
elements.text: The following cleaning operations should be carried out each day in order to maintain the performance of this machine and to ensure a long service life. Furthermore, if the sewing machine has not been used for a long period of time, carry out the following cleaning procedures before using it again.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 1. Cleaning

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Raise the presser foot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the two screws (1), and then remove the needle plate (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Use a soft wire brush to clean any dust from the feed dog (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install the needle plate (2) with the two screws (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tilt back the machine head.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the bobbin case (4).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Wipe off any dust from the rotary hook (5) with a soft cloth, and check that there is no damage to the rotary hook (5).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the bobbin from the bobbin case (4) and clean the bobbin case (4) with a cloth.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Insert the bobbin into the bobbin case (4), and then place the bobbin case (4) back into the machine.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 2. Lubrication

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: Oil tank oil quantity

elements.label: text
elements.text: Check the oil gauge window (1), and add more oil if the oil gauge (2) is below the lower reference line. (Refer to "3-3. Lubrication".)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3. Checking

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Replace the needle if it is bent or if the tip is broken.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check that the upper threads have been threaded correctly.

elements.label: text
elements.text: (Refer to "4-5. Threading the upper thread".)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Carry out a test sewing.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 11. ADJUSTING THE ROTARY HOOK LUBRICATION AMOUNT

elements.label: text
elements.text: Be careful not to touch your fingers or the lubrication amount check sheet against moving parts such as the rotary hook or the feed mechanism when checking the amount of oil supplied to the rotary hook. If care is not taken, injury may result.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use the following procedure to check the amount of oil being supplied to the rotary hook when replacing the rotary hook or when changing the sewing speed.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Checking the lubrication amount>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the thread from all points from the thread take-up lever to the needle.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Use the lifting lever to lift the presser foot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Run the machine at the normal sewing speed for approximately 10 minutes without sewing any material (following the same start/stop pattern as when actually sewing).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Place the lubrication amount check sheet (1) to the left of the rotary hook (2) and hold it there. Then run the sewing

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: machine at the normal sewing speed for 10 seconds. (Any type of paper can be used as the lubrication amount check sheet (1).)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check the amount of oil which has spattered onto the sheet.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If adjustment is necessary, carry out the following operations in "Adjusting the lubrication amount".

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: NOTE:

elements.label: text
elements.text: If the lubrication amount does not match the correct amount shown in the illustration at left (if the amount of spattered oil is too much or none at all), turn the adjusting screw (3) clockwise to fully tighten it, turn it back counterclockwise by 3 1/2 turns, and then carry out the following adjustment.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Adjusting the lubrication amount>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tilt back the machine head.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the adjusting screw (3) to adjust the lubrication amount.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ If the rotary hook adjusting screw (3) is turned clockwise, the lubrication amount becomes greater.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ If the rotary hook adjusting screw (3) is turned counterclockwise, the lubrication amount becomes smaller.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check the lubrication amount again according to the procedure given in "Checking the lubrication amount" above.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the rotary hook adjusting screw (3) and check the lubrication amount repeatedly until the lubrication amount is correct.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check the lubrication amount again after the sewing machine has been used for approximately two hours.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12. STANDARD ADJUSTMENTS

elements.label: text
elements.text: Maintenance and inspection of the sewing machine should only be carried out by a qualified technician.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Ask your Brother dealer or a qualified electrician to carry out any maintenance and inspection of the electrical system.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If any safety devices have been removed, be absolutely sure to re-install them to their original positions and check that they operate correctly before using the machine.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Secure the table so that it will not move when tilting back the machine head.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If the table moves, it may crush your feet or cause other injuries.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-1. Thread tension spring

elements.label: text
elements.text: Use both hands to hold the machine head when tilting it back or returning it to its original position.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If only one hand is used, the weight of the machine head may cause your hand to slip, and your hand may get caught.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn off the power switch and disconnect the power cord plug at the following times.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ･ When carrying out inspection, adjustment and maintenance

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ･ When replacing consumable parts such as the rotary hook and knives

elements.label: text
elements.text: If the power switch needs to be left on when carrying out some adjustment, make sure that you switch the sewing machine to maintenance mode.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Pay careful attention to safety.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Thread tension spring position>

elements.label: text
elements.text: The standard position of the thread take-up spring (1) is 6 to 7 mm (for -3 specifications) or 4 to 5 mm (for -5 specifications) above the surface of the arm thread guide (3) when the presser foot (2) is lowered.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Lower the presser foot (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the set screw (4).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the thread tension bracket (5) to adjust the spring position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Securely tighten the set screw (4).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If the lifting lever or other method has been used to raise the presser foot when adjusting the thread take-up spring, the movement amount of the thread take-up spring will be limited by the thread take-up spring stopper.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-2. Arm thread guide R

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Thread take-up spring tension>

elements.label: text
elements.text: The standard tension of the thread take-up spring (1) varies in accordance with the machine specifications as shown in the table.

elements.label: table_row
elements.text: -[][]3 specifications | 0.25 - 0.35N

elements.label: table_row
elements.text: -[][]5 specifications | 0.30 - 0.5N

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the upper thread slightly above the thread tension bracket (5) with a finger to stop the thread spooling out.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Pull the upper thread downward so that the thread take-up spring (1) is extended to the same height as the base of the arm thread guide (3), and then measure the tension of the thread take-up spring (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Insert the tip of a screwdriver into the groove in the thread tension stud (6) and turn it to adjust the tension of the thread tension spring (1).

elements.label: text
elements.text: NOTE: If using a tension gauge (7) (part code: 183922-101) to measure the tension, take the upper thread reading from the scale [at the red line side].

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Do not adjust the tension of the thread take-up spring if the presser foot has been raised by the lifting lever, or if the thread trimmer solenoid is ON.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The standard position of arm thread guide R (1) is the position where the screw (2) is in the center of the adjustable range for arm thread guide R (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: To adjust the position, loosen the screw (2) and then move arm thread guide R (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ When sewing heavy-weight material, move arm thread guide R (1) to the left. (The thread take-up amount will become greater.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ When sewing light-weight material, move arm thread guide R (1) to the right. (The thread take-up amount will become less.)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-3. Presser foot height

elements.label: text
elements.text: The standard height of the presser foot (1) is 6 mm when the presser foot (1) is raised by means of the lifting lever (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the nut (3), and then turn the adjustment screw (4) so that there is no pressure applied to the presser foot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Raise the presser foot (1) by using the lifting lever (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the rubber cap (5) from the face plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the bolt (6) and then move the presser bar (7) up or down until the presser foot (1) is at the standard height of 6 mm.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the bolt (6).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install the rubber cap (5).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust the presser foot pressure using the presser adjusting screw (4), and then tighten the nut (3).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-4. X-over seam sensor correction

elements.label: text
elements.text: Be sure to carry out this procedure when replacing the presser foot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn on the power.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the menu key (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Select the "X-over seam sensor correction" key (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to set the upper shaft position to between 110 and 290 degrees.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Lower the presser foot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the OK key (3).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-5. Adjusting the feed dog height

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn on the power.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Start backtack sewing, best PFM mode, slow start, special locus and X-over seam assist will turn off.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Set the feed pitch to 3 mm (for -[][]3 specifications) or to 5 mm (for -[][]5 specifications). (Refer to "5-4-3. Main sewing settings ".)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the menu key (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check the clearance A when the feed dog (2) is at the furthest forward position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: -[][]3 specifications: 0.5 mm

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: -[][]5 specifications: 3 mm

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The standard height of the feed dog (2) when it is raised as far as possible above the surface of the needle plate is 0.8 mm (for -[][]3 specifications) or 1.2 mm (for -[][]5 specifications).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to move the feed dog (2) to its highest position above the needle plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tilt back the machine head.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the set screw (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the feed lifting rock bracket stud (4) within a range of 90° from the reference line (5) to adjust the vertical height of the feed bar (6). (Fig. A)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the set screw (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If you are worried about the angle of the feed dog (2), turn the shaft (7) while carrying out the above adjustment. (Fig. (B))

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: (Refer to "12-6. Adjusting the feed dog angle" on the nextpage for details of this operation.)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-6. Adjusting the feed dog angle

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn on the power.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Start backtack sewing, best PFM mode, slow start, special locus and X-over seam assist will turn off.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Set the feed pitch to 3 mm (for -[][]3 specifications) or to 5 mm (for -[][]5 specifications). (Refer to "5-4-3. Main sewing settings ".)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the menu key (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The standard angle for the feed dog (2) when it is lowered until its top is flush with the top of the needle plate is for the O mark (or the V groove) in the feed bar shaft (3) to be aligned with the feed rocker bracket arm (4) and for the feed dog (2) and to be parallel to the needle plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to move the feed dog (2) to its highest position above the needle plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tilt back the machine head.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the set screw (5).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the feed base shaft (3) in the direction of the arrow within a range of 90º with respect to the standard position. (Figure <C>)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ In order to prevent puckering, lower the front of the feed dog (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ In order to prevent the material from slipping, raise the front of the feed dog (2).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Securely tighten the set screw (5).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the home key (6).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If you would like to tilt the feed dog (2) further, turn the feed lifting rock bracket stud (7) while carrying out the above adjustment. (Figure <D>) (Refer to "12-5. Adjusting the feed dog height" on the previous page for details of this operation.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The height of the feed dog (2) will change after the angle has been adjusted, so it will be necessary to re-adjust the height of the feed dog (2).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-7. Adjusting the needle bar height

elements.label: text
elements.text: Reference line (a) on the needle bar (1) should be aligned with the lower edge of the needle bar bush (2) as shown in the illustration when the needle bar (1) is at its lowest position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to set the needle bar (1) to its lowest position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the rubber cap (3) from the face plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw (4) and move the thread wiper (1) up or down to adjust its position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Securely tighten the screw (4).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install the rubber cap (3).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-8. Adjusting the needle and feed mechanism timing

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn on the power.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Start backtack sewing, best PFM mode, slow start, special locus and X-over seam assist will turn off.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Set the feed pitch to 3 mm (for -[][]3 specifications) or to 4 mm (for -[][]5 specifications). (Refer to "5-4-3. Main sewing settings ".)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the menu key (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The standard position for the point of the needle is as described below when the feed dog (2) is lowered from its highest position until it is aligned with the top of the needle plate (3).

elements.label: text
elements.text: This is the position where the top of the feed dog (2) and the top of the needle plate (3) are aligned, and the point of the needle is aligned with the bottom edge of the needle plate (3).

elements.label: text
elements.text: The top of the feed dog (2) and the top of the needle plate (3) are aligned, and there is a clearance of 1 to 4 mm between the point of the needle and the top of the needle plate (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tilt back the machine head.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the two set screws (5) of the feed lifting eccentric cam (4), and then turn the feed lifting eccentric cam (4) slightly to adjust the timing.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ To advance the needle timing, turn in the direction of <A>, and to retard the needle timing, turn in the direction of <B>.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ To prevent material slippage from occurring, retard the needle timing. (Fig. (B))

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ To improve thread tightening, advance the needle timing. (Fig. (A))

elements.label: text
elements.text: NOTE: If the feed lifting eccentric cam (4) is turned too far in the direction of <A>, it may cause the needle to break.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After adjusting, securely tighten the set screw (5).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press the home key (6).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-9. Needle and rotary hook timing

elements.label: text
elements.text: The rotary hook tip (3) should be aligned with the center of the needle (4) when the needle bar (1) moves up 1.8 mm (for -[][]3 specifications) or 2.2 mm (for -[][]5 specifications) from its lowest position to the position where reference line (b) is aligned with the needle bar bush (2) as shown in the illustration.

elements.label: text
elements.text: (The distance from the upper edge of the needle hole to the rotary hook tip will be 0.5 to 0.7 mm at this time.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to raise the needle bar (1) from its lowest position until reference line (b) is aligned with the lower edge of the needle bar bush (2) as shown in the illustration.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the three set screws (5), and then align the rotary

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: hook tip (3) with the center of the needle (4). There should be a gap of 0 to 0.1 mm (for -[][]3 specifications) or 0 to 0.15 mm (-[][]5 specifications) between the rotary hook tip (3) and the needle (4) at this time.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Securely tighten the three set screws (5).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Checking the clearance between the rotary hook and bobbin case holder position bracket>

elements.label: text
elements.text: Check that the clearance between the rotary hook (6) and the bobbin case holder position bracket (7) is enough to allow the thread being used to pass through smoothly.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The clearance should be 0.4 to 0.7 mm (for -[][]3 specifications) and 0.6 to 1.1 mm (for -[][]5 specifications).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-10. Adjusting the presser foot floating amount (minute lifting amount) (option)

elements.label: text
elements.text: When sewing stretch materials and materials with long pile, you can make minute adjustments to the floating amount for the presser foot (1) in accordance with the material.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the sewing machine pulley by hand to move the feed dog (2) below the needle plate (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Use the lifting lever to lower the presser foot (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the screw (4), and then replace the adjustment screw set (5) (option SB6564).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the adjusting screw (6) to adjust the floating amount.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ To raise the presser foot (1)…Turn the adjusting screw (6) clockwise.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ To lower the presser foot (1) ... Turn the adjusting screw (6) counterclockwise.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the nut (7).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After making the adjustment, sew a piece of material to check the floating amount.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12-11. Thread trimming

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn off the power switch.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the presser foot, needle plate and feed dog.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tilt back the machine head.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw (2) of the thread trimmer lever (1) and the screw (4) of the upper knife lever (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: (This will allow the upper and lower knife holders and the needle bar mechanism to operate independently.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install the lower knife (6) to the lower knife holder (7) with the two screws (5).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install the upper knife (10) with the two screws (8) and (9).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install the upper knife (10) so that it is almost parallel to the ridge line on the mounting surface of the upper knife holder (11).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If the upper knife (10) is tilted forward, the knife pressure will increase, and if it is tilted backward, the knife pressure will decrease.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After adjusting, operate the upper and lower knife holders by hand and check that the thread can be trimmed.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If using thick thread, or if the thread is not being trimmed, adjust the tilt of the upper knife (10) forward.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tilt the upper knife (10) forward slightly (about 0.3 mm) so that the ridge line on the mounting surface of the upper knife holder (11) is slightly visible.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: (The head of the screw (9) is pan-shaped, and so the upper knife (10) can pivot on this screw when it is tilted.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust the positions of the upper and lower knife holders so that the upper knife (10) and the lower knife (6) mesh and the tips of both knives are aligned at the center of the needle.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the screw (4) of the upper knife lever (3) to secure the upper knife (10) in place.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the screw (4) gently but securely at this time so that the upper knife lever (3) does not shift its position. As a guide, the screw (4) should be positioned in the center of the slot in the upper knife lever (3).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley while the thread trimmer solenoid is still turned on so that the thread trimmer cam (12) moves the thread trimmer cam roller (13) to its maximum displacement position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Make sure that the thread trimmer solenoid does not turn off and does not return during this step.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Set the maximum meshing amount for the upper and lower knives to 2 mm.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the thread trimmer lever (1) to align the tip of the upper knife (10) with the center of the index mark (14) on the lower knife (6).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Make sure that the tip of the upper knife (10) does not go past the index mark (14).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the screw (2) of the thread trimmer lever (1).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Make sure that there is no play in the thrust direction in the forked shaft (15) of the thread trimmer lever (1) (see illustration on page 8).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 12. STANDARD ADJUSTMENTS

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: <Thread trimming cam position adjustment>

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the machine pulley to raise the needle bar 6 mm from its lowest position (reference line (a) position) so that reference line (b) is aligned with the bottom edge of the needle bar bush.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: At the above position, push the plunger (1) of the thread trimming solenoid with your finger in the direction of the arrow.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Adjust the position of the thread trimmer cam (2) at this time so that the roller shaft (4) of the thread trimming cam lever assembly (3) touches the hollow (c) of the thread trimmer cam (2) and so that the clearance between the edge of the thread trimmer is 0.6 to 0.8 mm. (Fig. A)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check that the clearance between the edge of the thread trimmer cam (2) and the roller shaft (4) is 0.5 mm when the roller shaft (4) returns to the right. (Fig. (B))

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the two set screws (5) to approximately 4 N.m.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 13. LIST OF ERROR CODES

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: LIST OF ERROR CODES

elements.label: text
elements.text: If an error code appears on the touch panel display

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ Items with a "*" in the "Page" column should only be checked by a qualified technician.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ・ For items with "**" appearing in the "Page" column, ask the place of purchase for advice.

elements.label: section_header
